question.prompt: Lines \(AB\) and \(CD\) intersect at point \(O\), \(OE\perp AB\), and ray \(OE\) lies inside \(\angle AOD\). Given \(\angle AOC=50^\circ\), find the measure of \(\angle COE\) in degrees.

solutions.explanation: \(OA\) lies between \(OC\) and \(OE\), and \(\angle AOE=90^\circ\), so \(\angle COE=\angle AOC+\angle AOE=50^\circ+90^\circ=140^\circ\).
solutions.title: Add the adjacent angles
